storyCards.headline: If I Had No Loot: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Tony! Toni! Tone!'s "If I Had No Loot" reached #7 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #7 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

If I Had No Loot was released in 1993.

Chart story — peaked at #7 on the Hot 100.
